articles.title: Moderna raises 2026 outlook as CEO says newer vaccines are gaining traction
articles.description: The biotech company now expects 2026 revenue growth of 15% to 25%, up from its previous guidance of up to 10%.

articles.title: AI stocks hammered by midterm shock as data center buildout becomes a 'war of attrition'
articles.description: The election rout landed on an AI trade already under pressure from high interest rates, heavy capital spending and questions about returns.

articles.title: Live updates: Nasdaq 100 futures rally points to stock market respite

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures

articles.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains starting in 2027
